bayts.text: An Everlasting One (Al-Bāqī), Who has preserved me from Satan, has made the passage (of exile) pleasant for me like homelands.
I have begun in the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) and the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), the King of the ages.
He has opened, He Whose Name is the Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), for a Chosen One whose name is the Key (Al-Miftāḥ).
It has become clear to everyone who has righteousness that praising the Chosen One (Muḥammad) is success.
The Verses of Aḥmad have encompassed the Books of those to whom the Lord of creatures and of time gave revelation.
Our Prophet, al-Māḥī (the Effacer), has effaced all sorrow from us, just as he has accepted from us what was balanced.
Muḥammad — may the Possessor of beginningless Eternity bless him — my services gladden him perpetually.
Our Aḥmad, the Chosen, has turned harm toward others, away from my direction, forever, and (likewise) peril.
He has made endure the peace of our Lord, the Expediter (Al-Muqaddim), upon the Messenger and foremost Prophet.
Truly the son of ʿAbd Allāh (Muḥammad) has surpassed all creatures, every one, in rank and in character.
The peace of the Lord of the worlds, forever, upon the most sublime of the worlds, Aḥmad.
The blessing of the son of ʿAbd Allāh has led graces to the stillness and the motions of the pure elect.
The guidance of Abū l-Qāsim (Muḥammad) has illumined the breasts, with an illumination that puts to shame suns and full moons.
There yields to the Chosen One what yielded to the noble only by toil upon toil, among aspirations.
The Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ) has raised him with a raising that surpassed (all others), and has made purity and concord everlasting.
His praises have led to us righteousness, security, divine assistance and success.
We have attained felicity through him through whom He Who led the Sūras to him created the creatures.
The benefit of the Prophet for the Khadīm has been unveiled, and his love has freed the Khadīm from need of (any other) healing.
Allah has granted him all that he desired; upon him be His peace, from the best of fulfilments.
His Book is above all the Books, and its like, in what has passed, has never been written.
Whoever thought he could equal the Messenger will not obtain any request from his Lord.
Ṭā-Hā, son of ʿAbd Allāh, has surpassed everyone who has been created or will be created, with the Lord of time.
Toward him the prophets and messengers turn, on the Day when the precedence of any other than him is washed away.
He has gathered the intercession before which every other was powerless, on the Day when the promise was fulfilled.
Muḥammad — may Allah bless him — is the most excellent of what his Lord has created.
The light of the Prophet has removed the darkness, and his right guidance has removed blame.
His Criterion (Al-Furqān) has separated forever, from before, me from everyone who did not worship (Allah).
I have thanked my Lord in prose and in verse, together with the Prophet, and for me, through him, (He) has led immense things.
The benefit of the Messenger of Allah, the adornment of Muḍar, has become clear to me among the people of desert and town.
The Chosen One has led to me what he led for me, from his Lord, through his Lord, and it yielded.
